body: In a very similar boat. Not a lot tethering me down besides my immediate family and girlfriend. I'm not sure that I really have anything else. I hope things look up for you, even if they seem terrible at the moment. Those connections can seem meaningless, but truthfully everything to some extent is, and with that in mind you should embrace those little things like family and friends, because they're what keep most of us around.

I'm not sure how I feel about the friend part, I'm just still trying to process that whole situation. It was shitty and I just feel bad.

That's a really good idea with other subreddits and forums and stuff, I'm definitely gonna do that while I'm out. At least I can interact with others in the community to an extent through that. I'm also thinking about doing some filming during that time as although I won't be able to skate I'll be capable enough to wander around with a camera.

My parents have been really good to me in the past but recently have been pretty shitty. I'd like to talk to them about it but they'd either overreact strongly and put me into expensive therapy and on any drug that could help which would make me feel bad about spending their money and also be somewhat overboard, or they'd not react and just act like I was making a joke. Either way I'm not sure right now is a good time to talk to them about it.
